topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Learning Objectives
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture and outlines the intended learning outcomes regarding cancer treatment approaches.

topics.label: Conventional Cancer Treatments and Cytotoxic Chemotherapy
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine traditional modalities of cancer treatment, specifically surgery, radiotherapy, and cytotoxic chemotherapy alongside their mechanisms of action, toxicities, and drug resistance.

topics.label: Exploiting Intrinsic Cancer Cell Vulnerabilities and Defects
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics discuss therapeutic strategies that selectively target inherent cellular defects in cancer cells, including hormone dependencies, cell cycle checkpoint abnormalities, and defective DNA repair pathways.

topics.label: Oncogene Addiction and Kinase Inhibitor Therapies
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics cover targeted therapies directed against hyperactivated oncogenic kinases, exploring their structural design, therapeutic mechanisms, and the emergence of drug resistance and addiction.

topics.label: Monoclonal Antibody and Antibody-Drug Conjugate Therapies
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe antibody-based cancer therapeutics, detailing how naked monoclonal antibodies and antibody-drug conjugates target specific cell-surface proteins to destroy tumor cells.

topics.label: Cancer Immunotherapy and T-Cell Engagement
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how the immune system interacts with tumors and detail immunotherapeutic strategies, including immune checkpoint inhibitors, bispecific antibodies, and CAR T-cell therapies.

topics.label: Challenges, Future Directions, and Clinical Progress in Cancer Therapy
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics review broader clinical considerations in oncology, discussing systemic challenges such as resistance and heterogeneity, future therapeutic directions, and historical progress in patient outcomes.
